metadata.description: Self-hosted, cross-device memory for AI coding agents — the Mori plugin connects Claude Code, Cursor, and Antigravity to a Mori server you run.

plugins.name: mori
plugins.description: Persistent, cross-device memory for your AI coding agents — self-hosted and AGPL, so your knowledge never leaves your own infrastructure. Connect to a Mori server you run; every session distils into durable, searchable memory, so agents start informed, not cold. /brief loads context, /pensieve searches it.
